messages:
Marta (Finance): Heads up - Invoice 2026-221 from CloudForge NL shows VAT 0% and no VAT number. Amount EUR 12,000. Vendor portal has an OSS token but no VAT ID. Holding payment until clarified.
Evan (Payments): placed hold in AP. Reason: missing VAT ID / unclear tax treatment. :no_entry:
Lina (SalesOps): our rep says they always bill 0% due to OSS. But we're a Dublin-registered entity buying this as B2B. That sounds off.
Marta (Finance): exactly. For B2B we need either their VAT number and charged VAT or invoice with reverse-charge wording + our VAT ID (IE12345678).
Ravi (Legal): OSS is for B2C; can't rely on OSS for B2B. Ask vendor to reissue with one of: (1) supplier VAT ID and VAT amount, or (2) include "reverse charge - customer liable" plus our VAT ID. Also request a short attestation from their accountant if they insist on 0%.
vendor-support-bot: Vendor submitted a message: "We operate as a marketplace via OSS and don't have local VAT number. We can provide OSS confirmation or gross-up and add VAT."
Evan (Payments): gross-up acceptable if they reissue for total = net + VAT. Otherwise we need reissue with reverse-charge + our VAT ID. Hold remains.
Lina (SalesOps): i've asked their billing contact (Anja) to reissue by Thu. She said accounting is in NL and will respond.
Marta (Finance): action items: 1) Request reissued invoice with either supplier VAT ID + VAT or reverse-charge + our VAT IE12345678. 2) If vendor only provides OSS export, require signed accountant attestation plus procurement approval. 3) Payments to keep hold until invoice corrected.
Ravi (Legal): logging requirement: any attestation must include legal basis and be signed by an authorized accountant, and we must save the OSS filing reference. But still prefer supplier VAT ID or VAT charged.
Evan (Payments): noted. Will not pay until valid invoice uploaded.
Lina (SalesOps): vendor said EOD Thursday. will update once they reply.
Marta (Finance): Thanks. tagging AP ticket #AP-4892. Waiting on vendor reissue. :hourglass:
